limits: This verifier reads saved predictions and hashes artifact bytes; it does not deserialize checkpoints or retrain models.
Existing independent-audit.json results are corroborating saved evidence; this invocation does not rerun that Python audit.
Dataset source row IDs were not retained, so source-row partition disjointness is not established here.
Evaluation receipts are trusted-backend consistency records, not cryptographic attestations.
Historical recording-overhead benchmark measurements do not measure this library integration.
